verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a broad API/SDK/CLI surface covering agent creation, running, resuming, banning checks, listing runs, PR editing, integration management, sandbox log analysis, and run-log retrieval, suggesting strong feature parity with the UI (codegen-docs-15,16,27,34,35,36,37,39,40). However, there is no explicit statement of full UI-API parity, and a live probe found no published OpenAPI spec, plus some UI-only settings (agent-behavior toggles, permission controls) aren't clearly confirmed as API-configurable. Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee/documentation, a discoverable OpenAPI/schema reference, and confirmation that all settings-page controls (agent-behavior, permissions) are API-exposed.
